name: dsh-supercollider
description: SuperCollider for the agent: eleven sc_* tools that boot the audio server, compile and load SynthDefs, MEASURE what a sound actually is, and rewrite a patch while it sounds; a shelf of playable example instruments; five bundled skills that teach the language and the live-coding workflow; and a deliberately small console tab. Zero npm dependencies and no MCP server - one long-lived sclang session and a hand-written OSC client to scsynth.

scripts.check: node checks/check-sc-node.mjs && node checks/check-sc-wiring.mjs && node checks/check-sc-examples.mjs && node checks/check-sc-library.mjs
